'''Danite''' was a type of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] that could be used as a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Within the Adegan family of [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], danite was of medium rarity, being rarer than [[Relacite/Legends|relacite]] and more common than [[Mephite crystal/Legends|mephite]].<ref name="TotJC" /> Danite did not channel and focus energy as well as mephite,<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050707jc69|series=Jedi Counseling|text=69}}</ref> leading to a decreased severity of damage caused by the blade of a lightsaber using danite as a focusing crystal; however, in that regard it was still better than relacite.<ref name="TotJC" />

Either a danite or [[Kathracite crystal/Legends|kathracite]] crystal was present in each of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Training lightsaber/Legends|training lightsabers]]&mdash;a non-[[Death/Legends|lethal]] lightsaber variant that utilized an ultra-low-output [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] and created a blade that did not cause lasting damage to an opponent.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> The materials needed to craft a [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic]] danite crystal costed three hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
Danite was mentioned in the [[1996]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', written by [[George R. Strayton]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TotJC" />
